## Overview

A modal dialog used for confirmations.

`baseType: _component`

## Used By

- [Page Template](https://example.test/page)

## Component Elements

### 1. Wrapper

The dialog container.

- ARIA: role="dialog" with focus trapped while open; Escape closes it.
- Keyboard: Tab cycles within the dialog.

## Style Options

**Small** — default width. **Large** — wide width.

## Component Content

### Editable Fields

| Field Name | Field Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Heading | string | Yes | Rendered as h2. |
| Items | content | Yes | allowedTypes: ['ModalItem']. Min 1. |

### Dynamic Data

| Value Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| LD+JSON | A structured-data block per instance. |

specs.title: Acme Rebuild | Logo Ribbon
specs.bodyMarkdown:
| Batch | 1 |
| --- | --- |
| Document Status | APPROVED |
| Contains PII | NO |

## Overview

A row of partner logos.

## Component Elements

### 1. Logo Track

Holds the logos.

- ARIA: each logo image carries descriptive alt text.

### 2. Marquee Effect

An animated scroll treatment. No canonical primitive matched; used the design's name.

## Style Options

**Static** — no motion. **Animated** — pausable marquee.

## Component Content

### Editable Fields

| Field Name | Field Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Logos | content | Yes | allowedTypes: ['LogoItem']. |
